newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Westpac NZ mandated by Mercury to arrange CP issue.
newsitem.headline: Westpac NZ mandated by Mercury to arrange CP issue.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corporation (NZ) on Friday said it had been mandated by Mercury Energy to arrange a NZ$390 million commercial paper programme, with the maiden issue expected in late October or early November.
Dennis Andrews, general manager finance of Mercury, said the commercial paper programme would be used to meet general funding requirments and represented Mercury's entrance to the capital markets.
"With strong credit ratings from Standard & Poor's of AA- and A-1+, Mercury intendes to be a regular issuer under this programme," Andrews said in a statement.
